nws_point_forecast.detail: nws_client.daily_high_forecast exists for live/prospective pulls; no archived same-vintage NWS forecast time series matched to decision hours is wired into this candidate harness yet.

hrrr.detail: HRRR (https://rapidrefresh.noaa.gov/hrrr/) is not ingested. Requires AWS/NOMADS archival access, station extraction, and issue-time alignment. Do not substitute reanalysis. Prospective collection recommended.

claim: No claim is made that observation-only candidates beat external forecasts.
